# calendar

16 curated tools, plus 24 generated tools (Google Discovery parameter names; see `calendar_discover`).

## `calendar_add_subscription`

Class: create

Add an existing calendar (one shared with the account, a public one, a colleague's) to the account's calendar list, so it shows up in calendar_list_calendars. To create a new calendar use calendar_create_calendar.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `calendarId` | string | required | ID of the calendar to add, usually its email address |
| `summaryOverride` | string | optional | Name to show for this calendar in this account's list (does not rename the calendar for anyone else) |
| `colorId` | string | optional | Colour from the Google palette, e.g. "9" (see the colors API); ignored when backgroundColor is given |
| `backgroundColor` | string | optional | Hex background colour such as "#16a765"; use together with foregroundColor |
| `foregroundColor` | string | optional | Hex text colour such as "#000000" |
| `hidden` | boolean | optional | Hide the calendar from the list without unsubscribing |
| `selected` | boolean | optional | Show the calendar's events in this account's calendar view |

## `calendar_get_freebusy`

Class: read

Check free/busy times for one or more calendars within a time window. Returns only busy blocks, not event details.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `calendarIds` | array | required | Calendar IDs to check, e.g. ["primary", "user@example.com"] |
| `timeMin` | string | required | ISO 8601 start of window |
| `timeMax` | string | required | ISO 8601 end of window |
| `timeZone` | string | optional | Timezone (default: UTC) |

## `calendar_remove_subscription`

Class: delete

Remove a calendar from the account's calendar list (unsubscribe). The calendar and its events are not deleted and stay available to everyone else; the account can add it back with calendar_add_subscription if it still has access.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `calendarId` | string | required | ID of the calendar to remove from the list |

## `calendar_suggest_times`

Class: read

Find meeting times when you and the other people are all free. Checks free/busy for your primary calendar and each attendee calendar, then returns the earliest open slots inside working hours (default 09:00-17:00 Monday to Friday, in timeZone). Read-only: it proposes times and creates nothing; use calendar_create_event to book one.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias; "*" = all accounts; omit for the default account |
| `durationMinutes` | integer | optional | Meeting length in minutes (default 30) |
| `attendees` | array | optional | Calendar IDs or email addresses of the other people (up to 20). Omit to find free time on your own calendar |
| `timeMin` | string | optional | ISO 8601 start of the search window, with a Z or UTC offset (default: now) |
| `timeMax` | string | optional | ISO 8601 end of the search window, with a Z or UTC offset (default: 7 days after the start; at most 31 days) |
| `timeZone` | string | optional | IANA zone the working hours are in, e.g. "Europe/Paris" (default: the time zone of your primary calendar) |
| `workStart` | string | optional | Earliest start of day as HH:MM (default "09:00") |
| `workEnd` | string | optional | Latest end of day as HH:MM (default "17:00") |
| `includeWeekends` | boolean | optional | Also search Saturdays and Sundays (default false) |
| `bufferMinutes` | integer | optional | Free minutes to keep before and after every existing meeting (default 0) |
| `maxSuggestions` | integer | optional | How many slots to return (default 5) |

## `calendar_update_subscription`

Class: update

Change how a calendar appears in the account's calendar list: its display name, colour, whether it is hidden or selected. Only the fields you pass change. To change the calendar itself (title, time zone) it must be edited by its owner.

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `account` | string | optional | Google account alias |
| `calendarId` | string | required | ID of a calendar already in the account's list |
| `summaryOverride` | string | optional | Name to show for this calendar in this account's list (does not rename the calendar for anyone else) |
| `colorId` | string | optional | Colour from the Google palette, e.g. "9" (see the colors API); ignored when backgroundColor is given |
| `backgroundColor` | string | optional | Hex background colour such as "#16a765"; use together with foregroundColor |
| `foregroundColor` | string | optional | Hex text colour such as "#000000" |
| `hidden` | boolean | optional | Hide the calendar from the list without unsubscribing |
| `selected` | boolean | optional | Show the calendar's events in this account's calendar view |
